annotation.bound_parties_text: The bill designates as "actors of AI" providers, deployers, importers and distributors, product manufacturers, authorised representatives and affected persons, and makes certification mandatory for the national public sector.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Serán actores de la I.A. para la presente Ley: a) los proveedores que introduzcan en el mercado o pongan en servicio sistemas de IA
